title: Long Description Truncation
description: This task has a very long description to test the 'more' and 'less' toggle functionality on the home screen. It should be truncated to exactly one line in the collapsed state, with the toggle button pinned to the right. This ensures the list stays clean even when tasks contain a massive amount of technical documentation or notes. Tapping 'more' will expand it to show the full Markdown content including headers and lists.
